summary: Variables for the containerized AAP growth topology inventory: postgresql_admin_username/password, registry_username/password, redis_mode=standalone, and admin and PostgreSQL host/password variables for gateway, controller (with controller_percent_memory_capacity=0.5), hub (hub_seed_collections=false) and EDA.
questions: Which variables are required for an all-in-one containerized AAP install?
What is redis_mode for the growth topology?
How do I set the controller memory capacity in containerized AAP?

answer_card.title: Containerized AAP growth topology: required variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
postgresql_admin_username=postgres
postgresql_admin_password=<set your own>
registry_username=<your RHN username>
registry_password=<your RHN password>
redis_mode=standalone

gateway_admin_password=<set your own>
gateway_pg_host=aap.example.org
gateway_pg_password=<set your own>
controller_admin_password=<set your own>
controller_pg_host=aap.example.org
controller_pg_password=<set your own>
hub_admin_password=<set your own>
hub_pg_host=aap.example.org
hub_pg_password=<set your own>
eda_admin_password=<set your own>
eda_pg_host=aap.example.org
eda_pg_password=<set your own>
```
